newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady in thin trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady to slightly lower on Thursday in very thin trading, finding some comfort by a rebound in NYMEX gasoline futures despite sluggish crude oil prices.
Eurograde barges ended down $1 at $202/$204 fob ARA and regular unleaded finished at $197/$199.
Cargo trading was also quiet with the arbitrage seen shut for smaller vessels and possibly feasible for larger 60,000 tonne carriers.
In eastern Europe, demand from Poland has not picked up after Poland fully liberalised fuel prices earlier this month, sources said.

The finance ministry freed prices of fuels and removed all administrative limits on profit margins applied to engine fuel trade in leaded and unleaded petrol as well as diesel fuel, as of February 13.
"There is no direct impact so far...There is no buying from the three majors yet," one source said, adding that they may step up their purchases as early as next week.
